# f5xc_fleet (Resource)

Fleet is used to configure infrastructure components (like nodes) in one or<br>more F5XC customer edge sites homogeneously. Fleet configuration has<br>following information,<br>* Software image release to be deployed on the fleet<br>* List of devices to be configured on every node<br>* Connections between the virtual networks in the site<br>* Security policies applied in the site<br><br>Fleet object must be created in the 'system' namespace for the tenant<br><br>Associating Fleet with Site<br><br>Fleet has a field called 'fleet_label'. When a fleet object is created, system automatically creates a known_label<br>'ves.io/fleet=<fleet_label>'. The known_label is created in the 'shared' namespace for the tenant.<br>A site is made 'member of fleet' when this known_label is added to the site. A site can have at most one known_label<br>of type 'ves.io/fleet' and hence belongs to exactly one fleet at any given time.<br><br>When a site becomes member of fleet, all nodes in site also become 'member of fleet'. The fleet configuration<br>is applied on all nodes that are member of the fleet.<br><br>Fleet and Virtual Site<br><br>Both Fleet and Virtual Sites select a list of sites based on the labels. But, there is a major difference between<br>virtual_site and Fleet. Virtual_sites are intersecting sub sets of available sites. Fleet is non intersecting subset<br>of available sites compared to other Fleets. As a result, at most one Fleet configuration if applied on a Site.<br><br>However to enable other features like monitoring, deploying application or jobs on sites represented by fleet,<br>system will automatically create a virtual_site in shared namespace representing all sites in a fleet.

To get more information about f5xc_fleet, refer:

- [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/fleet)

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Fleet - Full

resource "f5xc_fleet" "example" {
  name        = "example-fleet"
  namespace   = "system"
  description = "Full fleet example"

  fleet_label = "example-fleet"

  labels = {
    env  = "example"
    tier = "full"
  }

  enable_default_fleet_config_download = true

  bond_choice = {
    no_bond_devices = true
  }

  dc_cluster_group_choice = {
    no_dc_cluster_group = true
  }

  gpu_choice = {
    disable_gpu = true
  }

  interface_choice = {
    default_config = true
  }

  logs_receiver_choice = {
    logs_streaming_disabled = true
  }

  sriov_interface_choice = {
    default_sriov_interface = true
  }

  storage_class_choice = {
    default_storage_class = true
  }

  storage_device_choice = {
    no_storage_device = true
  }

  storage_interface_choice = {
    no_storage_interfaces = true
  }

  storage_static_routes_choice = {
    no_storage_static_routes = true
  }

  usb_policy_choice = {
    deny_all_usb = true
  }

  vm_choice = {
    disable_vm = true
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `fleet_label` (String) fleet_label fleet_label value is used to create known_label 'ves.io/fleet=<fleet_label>' The known_label is created in the 'shared' namespace for the tenant. A virtual_site object with name <fleet_label> is also created in 'shared' namespace for tenant. The virtual_site object will select all sites configured with the known_label above fleet_label with 'sfo' will create a known_label 'ves.io/fleet=sfo' in tenant for the fleet
- `name` (String) name This is the name of configuration object. It has to be unique within the namespace. It can only be specified during create API and cannot be changed during replace API. The value of name has to follow DNS-1035 format.
- `namespace` (String) namespace This defines the workspace within which each the configuration object is to be created. Must be a DNS_LABEL format. For a namespace object itself, namespace value will be ''
- `storage_device_choice` (Attributes) Storage Device Configuration Configure external storage devices for this fleet<br>Exactly one of `no_storage_device` or `storage_device_list` must be specified. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--storage_device_choice))

Required:

- `arrays` (Attributes) Arrays Configuration This section configure PSO storage arrays (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--storage_device_choice--storage_device_list--storage_devices--device_choice--pure_service_orchestrator--arrays))
- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID clusterID is added as a prefix for all volumes created by this PSO installation. clusterID is also used to identify the volumes used by the datastore, pso-db. clusterID MUST BE UNIQUE for multiple K8s clusters running on top of the same storage arrays. characters allowed: alphanumeric and underscores<br>**Validation:** `Length LengthBetween(1, 22)`

Optional:

- `enable_storage_topology` (Boolean) Enable Storage Topology This option is to enable/disable the csi topology feature for pso-csi<br>**Default:** `false`
- `enable_strict_topology` (Boolean) Enable Strict Topology This option is to enable/disable the strict csi topology feature for pso-csi<br>**Default:** `false`

<a id="nestedatt--interface_choice--device_list"></a>
### Nested Schema for `interface_choice.device_list`

Optional:

- `devices` (Attributes List) Add device for all interfaces belonging to this fleet Configuration for all devices in the fleet. Examples of devices are - network interfaces, cameras, scanners etc. Configuration a device is applied on VER node if the VER node is member of this fleet and has an corresponding interface/device. The mapping from device configured in fleet with interface/device in VER node depends on the type of device and is documented in device instance specific sections (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interface_choice--device_list--devices))

<a id="nestedatt--interface_choice--device_list--devices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `interface_choice.device_list.devices`

Required:

- `device_instance_choice` (Attributes) Device Instance Device Instance specifies the type of interface and its characteristics<br>`network_device` must be specified. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interface_choice--device_list--devices--device_instance_choice))
- `owner` (List of String) Owner Defines ownership of the device. A device can be owned by, * VER : Devices like ethernet are owned by VER * VK8S Workload : The devices is available for VK8S workload use. This option is not yet supported * HOST : Device is owned by host-os. The devices can be exposed via some other services like TPM. This option is not yet supported<br>**Allowed Values (choose one):** `['DEVICE_OWNER_HOST', 'DEVICE_OWNER_INVALID', 'DEVICE_OWNER_VER', 'DEVICE_OWNER_VK8S_WORK_LOAD']`

Optional:

- `name` (String) Name Name of the device including the unit number (e.g. eth0 or disk1). The name must match name of device in host-os of node

<a id="nestedatt--interface_choice--device_list--devices--device_instance_choice"></a>
### Nested Schema for `interface_choice.device_list.devices.device_instance_choice`

Optional:

- `network_device` (Attributes) Networking Device Device instance is a networking device like ethernet (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interface_choice--device_list--devices--device_instance_choice--network_device))

<a id="nestedatt--interface_choice--device_list--devices--device_instance_choice--network_device"></a>
### Nested Schema for `interface_choice.device_list.devices.device_instance_choice.network_device`

Required:

- `interface` (Attributes List) Network Interface Network Interface attributes for the device. User network interface configuration for this network device. Attributes like labels, MTU from the 'interface' are applied to corresponding interface in VER node If network interface refers to a virtual-network, the virtual-netowrk type must be consistent with use attribute given below If use is NETWORK_INTERFACE_USE_REGULAR, the virtual-network must be of type VIRTUAL_NETWORK_SITE_LOCAL or VIRTUAL_NETWORK_SITE_LOCAL_INSIDE if use is NETWORK_INTERFACE_USE_OUTSIDE, the virtual-network must of type VIRTUAL_NETWORK_SITE_LOCAL if use is NETWORK_INTERFACE_USE_INSIDE, the virtual-network must of type VIRTUAL_NETWORK_SITE_LOCAL_INSIDE (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interface_choice--device_list--devices--device_instance_choice--network_device--interface))
- `use` (List of String) Use Defines how the device is used. 'use' specifies how the device is used in node Specifies if the network interface is connected to inside network or outside network.<br>**Allowed Values (choose one):** `['NETWORK_INTERFACE_USE_INSIDE', 'NETWORK_INTERFACE_USE_OUTSIDE', 'NETWORK_INTERFACE_USE_REGULAR']`

(see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--performance_enhancement_mode--perf_mode_choice))

### Nested Schema for `storage_class_choice.storage_class_list.storage_classes`

(see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--storage_class_choice--storage_class_list--storage_classes--device_choice))

- `storage_device` (String) Storage Device Storage device that this class will use. The Device name defined at previous step.

Optional:

- `allow_volume_expansion` (Boolean) Allow Volume Expansion Allow volume expansion.<br>**Default:** `false`
- `default_storage_class` (Boolean) Default Storage Class Make this storage class default storage class for the K8s cluster<br>**Default:** `false`
- `description` (String) Storage Class Description Description for this storage class<br>**Validation:** `Length LengthAtMost(256)`
- `reclaim_policy` (String) Reclaim Policy Reclaim Policy<br>**Validation:** `Length LengthAtMost(16)`

<a id="nestedatt--storage_class_choice--storage_class_list--storage_classes--device_choice"></a>

(see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--storage_class_choice--storage_class_list--storage_classes--device_choice--custom_storage))
- `hpe_storage` (Attributes) HPE Storage Storage configuration for HPE Storage<br>Conflicts with `custom_storage`, `netapp_trident`, and `pure_service_orchestrator`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--storage_class_choice--storage_class_list--storage_classes--device_choice--hpe_storage))
- `netapp_trident` (Attributes) NetApp Trident Storage class Device configuration for NetApp Trident<br>Conflicts with `custom_storage`, `hpe_storage`, and `pure_service_orchestrator`. ### Nested Schema for `storage_class_choice.storage_class_list.storage_classes.device_choice.custom_storage`

Optional:

- `yaml` (String) Storage Class YAML K8s YAML for StorageClass<br>**Validation:** `Length LengthAtMost(4096)`


<a id="nestedatt--storage_class_choice--storage_class_list--storage_classes--device_choice--hpe_storage"></a>
### Nested Schema for `storage_class_choice.storage_class_list.storage_classes.device_choice.hpe_storage`

Optional:

- `allow_mutations` (String) allowMutations mutation can override specified parameters<br>**Validation:** `Length LengthAtMost(256)`
- `allow_overrides` (String) allowOverrides PVC can override specified parameters<br>**Validation:** `Length LengthAtMost(256)`
- `dedupe_enabled` (Boolean) dedupeEnabled Indicates that the volume should enable deduplication.<br>**Default:** `true`
- `description` (String) Description The SecretName parameter is used to identify name of secret to identify backend storage's auth information<br>**Validation:** `Length LengthAtMost(512)`
- `destroy_on_delete` (Boolean) destroyOnDelete Indicates the backing Nimble volume (including snapshots) should be destroyed when the PVC is deleted<br>**Default:** `false`
- `encrypted` (Boolean) encrypted Indicates that the volume should be encrypted.<br>**Default:** `false`
- `folder` (String) folder The name of the folder in which to place the volume.<br>**Validation:** `Length LengthAtMost(128)`
- `limit_iops` (Number) limitIops The IOPS limit of the volume.
- `limit_mbps` (Number) limitMbps The IOPS limit of the volume.
- `performance_policy` (String) performancePolicy The name of the performance policy to assign to the volume.<br>**Validation:** `Length LengthAtMost(128)`
- `pool` (String) pool The name of the pool in which to place the volume.<br>**Validation:** `Length LengthAtMost(128)`
- `protection_template` (String) protectionTemplate The name of the performance policy to assign to the volume.<br>**Validation:** `Length LengthAtMost(128)`
- `secret_name` (String) Secret Name The SecretName parameter is used to identify name of secret to identify backend storage's auth information<br>**Validation:** `Length LengthAtMost(256)`
- `secret_namespace` (String) Secret Namespace The SecretNamespace parameter is used to identify name of namespace where secret resides<br>**Validation:** `Length LengthAtMost(256)`
- `sync_on_detach` (Boolean) syncOnDetach Indicates that a snapshot of the volume should be synced to the replication partner each time it is detached from a node.<br>**Default:** `false`
- `thick` (Boolean) thick Indicates that the volume should be thick provisioned.<br>**Default:** `false`


<a id="nestedatt--storage_class_choice--storage_class_list--storage_classes--device_choice--netapp_trident"></a>
### Nested Schema for `storage_class_choice.storage_class_list.storage_classes.device_choice.netapp_trident`

Optional:

- `selector` (Map of String) Selector Using the Selector field, each StorageClass calls out which virtual pool(s) may be used to host a volume. The volume will have the aspects defined in the chosen virtual pool.
- `storage_pools` (String) Storage Pools The storagePools parameter is used to further restrict the set of pools that match any specified attributes<br>**Validation:** `Length LengthAtMost(512)`


<a id="nestedatt--storage_class_choice--storage_class_list--storage_classes--device_choice--pure_service_orchestrator"></a>
### Nested Schema for `storage_class_choice.storage_class_list.storage_classes.device_choice.pure_service_orchestrator`

Optional:

- `backend` (String) Backend Defines type of Pure storage backend block or file. The volume will have the aspects defined in the chosen virtual pool.<br>**Default:** `block`<br>**Allowed Values (choose one):** `['block', 'file']`
- `bandwidth_limit` (String) Bandwidth Limit It must be between 1 MB/s and 512 GB/s. Enter the size as a number (bytes must be multiple of 512) or number with a single character unit symbol. Valid unit symbols are K, M, G, representing KiB, MiB, and GiB.<br>**Validation:** `Length LengthAtMost(12)`
- `iops_limit` (Number) IOPS Limit Enable IOPS limitation. It must be between 100 and 100 million. If value is 0, IOPS limit is not defined.<br>**Default:** `0`

## Import

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an `import` block to import this resource by ID.

> **Note:** Replace placeholder values (for example, `<namespace>`, `<name>`) with actual values.

#### Command-Line Import

Use the following `command` to import this resource from the command line:

```shell
terraform import f5xc_fleet.example <namespace>/<name>
```

#### HCL Import Block

Use the following `hcl` block to import this resource during `plan` or `apply`:

```hcl
import {
	id = "<namespace>/<name>"
	to = f5xc_fleet.example
}
```
